name: com.mjgame.nmd.nkl.20
description: Text effects, styles and helpers built on top of TextMeshPro. Effects edit vertex data only, so text is never regenerated per frame.

samples.description: One scene with five tabs: effects, layouts, a 100-item shop, extras (built-in tags, dialogue with sound and fade out, number formatting, runtime settings) and world (3D) texts. Needs TMP Essential Resources.
